name: smwmusic-pulseman-stereo-protect-snes-trance-mix
title: Pulseman - Stereo Protect (SNES TRANCE MIX)
description:
Stereo Protect from Pulseman, but remixed and extended to give off a more trance-like feel. Good for abstract and space levels, along with longer and spaced-out levels in general.

NOTE: Not compatible with thunder, Blaargs and Yoshis.
